name: Rwanda National Multidimensional Poverty Index (EICV7)
method: Alkire–Foster adjusted headcount ratio (M0), dual cut-off
unit_of_identification: Household (all members share the household's deprivation score)
poverty_cutoff_label: Deprived in at least 1/3 (33.3%) of weighted indicators
source: NISR, EICV7 Thematic Report: Multidimensional Poverty, pp. 22–23
changes_vs_eicv5: 13 indicators instead of 14: bank-account indicator removed (future EICV rounds will not capture it)
Charcoal no longer counted as cooking-fuel deprivation
Assets indicator broadened to mobility assets
School attendance age 6–11 (was 7–15); years of schooling eligible age 12+ (was 15–60)
Housing materials considers floor, walls and roof (was floor only)
Overcrowding threshold >3 persons per sleeping room (was >4)

indicators.label: School attendance
indicators.deprived_if: At least one school-aged child (6–11 years) in the household is not attending school.

indicators.label: Years of schooling
indicators.deprived_if: No household member aged 12+ has completed at least 6 years of schooling.

indicators.label: Access to health care
indicators.deprived_if: Household lives more than 3 km from a health facility (health post, health centre or district hospital).

indicators.label: Health insurance
indicators.deprived_if: At least one household member has no health insurance.

indicators.label: Electricity
indicators.deprived_if: Household has no improved electricity (not connected to REG/other distributors and no solar panel system).

indicators.label: Drinking water
indicators.deprived_if: No improved drinking-water source, or source more than 500 m away (rural) / 200 m (urban).

indicators.label: Sanitation
indicators.deprived_if: No improved sanitation (no flush toilet or pit latrine with slab).

indicators.label: Cooking fuel
indicators.deprived_if: Household cooks with solid fuel (dung, wood, crop residue, shrubs or coal); charcoal is not counted as deprivation.

indicators.label: Garbage disposal
indicators.deprived_if: Garbage not disposed in a publicly managed refuse area, collection service, or own compost heap.

indicators.label: Housing materials
indicators.deprived_if: Inadequate (natural or rudimentary) material in any of floor, roof or walls.

indicators.label: Assets
indicators.deprived_if: Household owns no more than one of: radio, TV, telephone, computer, bicycle, motorbike, refrigerator — and no car/truck.

indicators.label: Overcrowding
indicators.deprived_if: More than 3 household members per sleeping room.

indicators.label: Subsistence farming
indicators.deprived_if: Household is only engaged in subsistence agriculture and works as agricultural labourers.
